deviations_from_plan: E1 and the speech-cost run were first started at 00:48 UTC on 2026-10-12. Importing the Silero VAD library reset torch to one thread, which made them far slower than planned. I noticed at about 02:06 UTC, fixed the gate to restore the thread count (commit 9f023c7), discarded all E1 output from that attempt, and re-ran E1 and the speech-cost run from the start at 48 threads, as the plan states. E2 never loads the VAD and was not affected. Nothing from the discarded attempt is used.
After the run started I read the raw output of the 39M model only to check that it was non-empty and how often it hit the token cap. No error rate or contrast was looked at before analyze.py ran.
